errors.SLUG_TAKEN: That link is already used by another combo. Change the link.
errors.STALE: Someone else changed this combo meanwhile. Close it and open it again.
errors.OWNER_OK_REQUIRED: A set price is the owner's decision. Ask the owner (or someone he gave the price permission to).
errors.NOT_READY: It cannot go on sale yet: {fields}.
errors.KEY_FIXED: The link of a combo rule cannot change once it is made: the shared link must keep working.
errors.SET_INVALID: This set cannot go in the bag as picked: {fields}.
errors.CART_NOT_OPEN: The bag is no longer open.
errors.NO_PIECE_PHOTO: A piece has no photo in its colour yet, so the set photo cannot be made (pieces {fields}).
errors.NO_STORAGE: Photo storage is not connected yet.
errors.not-found: That page of the admin does not exist.
errors.method-not-allowed: That action is not possible here.

combos.title: Combos
combos.subtitle: Combos — colour pairs make themselves
combos.intro: Upload a product, pick a category or style here and say 2 pieces or 3 — every colour pair becomes its own combo on the shop. What you change here changes on the shop at once.
combos.sameColour: Two of the same colour still get the combo price
combos.sameColourOf: Two of the same colour still get the combo price — {name}

price.pieceNoPrice: A piece has no price yet, so the set cannot be sold.
price.notLower: Not lower than the regular {regular}. Customers will pay the regular {regular} and no set saving is shown. Enter a price below {regular} to make it an offer.
price.bagsFollow: sets already in bags move to this price

blocking.NO_PIECES: It needs at least two pieces.
blocking.NO_PAIRS: The rule makes no combos yet.

fixed.title: Fixed combos & customer sets
fixed.intro: Fixed combos you put together, and the groups customers may mix themselves. Prices here are what the bag and checkout use.
fixed.autoText: when the bag has every item of an active combo, the set price is applied by itself — even if the customer added the items one by one.

editor.slugHelp: Small letters, digits and dashes. Shared links keep working: change it only before you share it.
editor.coloursAny: Any colour (tap colours to allow only those):
editor.priceOwner: Only the owner (or someone he allowed) can set a price.
editor.priceBad: The set price is not a number.
editor.previewEmpty: Give it a name and pick its pieces to see the price.

dates.endsHelp: After the end date it stops by itself and moves to the archive; its page stays open.
dates.alwaysHelp: Without dates it runs all the time.

toast.priceSaved: Set price saved — the bag and checkout use it
toast.onNotLive: {name} is on — it sells from its start date
toast.off: {name} is off — moved to the archive; its page says the offer has ended
toast.autoOn: {name} applies by itself when the bag matches
toast.sameOn: {name} — two of the same colour now get the combo price
toast.sameOff: {name} — only different colours get the combo price
toast.created: {name} saved as a draft — switch it on when it is ready
